works.title: The Supreme Chumps
works.description: A satirical fictional narrative about U.S. Supreme Court justices and their backroom deliberations. Planned as a scathing character study with nine profiles (one per justice), revealing corruption and moral failure through emotionally resonant, internally consistent storytelling. Framed as a Trump-era reckoning to permanently define these justices' legacies.
works.quote: This tells me I got another book to write. The supreme chumps. I am gonna have to come up with nine character profiles representing the Supreme Court and I'm gonna write about their back room deliberations.
